# Spatial Bin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SpatialBin`](gmeow-SpatialBin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SpatialBin>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/aggregation`](../../slices/aggregation.md)

A place that serves as a spatial bin in an aggregation grid — a generated region used to partition space for statistical summarisation. Its geometry defines the bin boundary; its aggregation result is a [`SpatialAggregation`](gmeow-SpatialAggregation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Place`](gmeow-Place.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SpatialBin`](gmeow-SpatialBin.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Place`](gmeow-Place.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
